scope: One ordinary mining/reveal trial selected by disclosed offline save inspection; portable checks validate retained evidence, not a replay.

preparation.method: Copied the prior furniture-reinstall endpoint into an isolated profile. The earlier scene includes developer-prepared structures and history. The entrance was selected using disclosed offline save decoding; no runtime state injection or edited game saves.

limitations: One selected outdoor clearing and one ordinary mining route; not a roofed cave, cave-generator frequency sample, or general exploration benchmark.
Offline decoding was used to select the route. This is not a screen-only blind exploration experiment.
The clearing is larger than600 cells and extends beyond the camera. An observed Area revealed letter cannot isolate the >=600 branch from the off-screen branch.
Elapsed saved ticks include walking, UI operations and job work; no exact mining duration or throughput is inferred from input pulse lengths.
The inherited baseline contains earlier developer preparation. No developer action or save edit is used in this trial.
Full saves, full screenshots and derived C# remain local. Public screenshots are cropped to relevant game UI and exclude unrelated Steam notifications.
Action039 pulse was issued while the post-save main menu was still open; action040 closes it and action041 onward advances the map. That menu pulse is retained and not counted as mining work.
The miner may change through ordinary job scheduling. All three colonists are retained; the endpoint alone does not identify which colonist delivered the final mining hit.
All recorded pulse actions, including039, use Space to pause. The main-menu pulse039 does not prove simulation advancement; native saved ticks remain authoritative.

The074 quit input was followed by a foreground capture refusal. Because the action sidecar is written after capture, neither a074 image nor a completed074 action record exists; the exit record and fresh process query establish shutdown.
